meta.title: Rehlaty — Best flight and hotel prices
meta.description: Compare flight and hotel prices from global suppliers, and book it yourself in a few steps.

home.title: The best price for your trip, without checking ten sites
home.subtitle: We compare flight and hotel prices across several global suppliers in a single search, and show the final price including taxes — no surprises at the last step.

trust.priceTitle: The final price, from the first screen
trust.priceBody: Every price shown includes taxes and fees. Before payment we re-confirm it with the supplier and tell you if it moved.
trust.suppliersBody: We query every available supplier at once. If one goes down, results still arrive from the rest.
trust.selfServeBody: Create an account, save traveller details, and manage your bookings — change, cancel and track from your dashboard.

status.stageNotice: Live search is wired up in the next stage. The interface, design system and localisation are in place now.
